description: Election Commission - Declare that M. Vickneswaran as a Member of the Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter.
